table.name: TLGNR_BILLTO_RULETYPE_BS
table.description: Ruletypes for selecting the Bill-To of an order (see Haendlerrhythmus).

column.name: BILLTO_RULETYPE_CD
column.description: PK. 0=month (Jan, Feb, Mar, ...), 1=day of week (Mon, Tue, Wed, ...), 2=day of month (1, 2, 3, ...)

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
